TABLE admin_account_security
  username text NOT NULL
  owner_pass_hash text
  owner_totp_secret text
  owner_totp_set boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  totp_deadline timestamp with time zone
  updated timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  owner_email text
  owner_last_access timestamp with time zone
  CONSTRAINT admin_account_security_pkey PRIMARY KEY (username)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_account_security_pkey ON public.admin_account_security USING btree (username)

  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX admin_preferences_pkey ON public.admin_preferences USING btree (username, key)

TABLE ai_costs

  recognized boolean

  CREATE INDEX ai_costs_ts_idx ON public.ai_costs USING btree (ts DESC)

TABLE appointment_events
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('appointment_events_id_seq'::regclass)
  request_id integer NOT NULL
  kind text NOT NULL
  actor text
  status_from text
  status_to text
  appointment_from timestamp with time zone
  appointment_to timestamp with time zone
  attendance_from text
  attendance_to text
  created timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT appointment_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT fk_appointment_events_request FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES booking_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_events_pkey ON public.appointment_events USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX appointment_events_request_idx ON public.appointment_events USING btree (request_id, id)

TABLE appointment_offers
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('appointment_offers_id_seq'::regclass)
  slot_at timestamp with time zone
  service_id text
  center_slug text
  waitlist_id integer
  token text
  sent_at timestamp with time zone
  expires_at timestamp with time zone
  status text DEFAULT 'ofrecida'::text
  created timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT appointment_offers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT appointment_offers_token_key UNIQUE (token)
  CONSTRAINT fk_appointment_offers_waitlist FOREIGN KEY (waitlist_id) REFERENCES waitlist(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CREATE INDEX appointment_offers_current_idx ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (status, expires_at) WHERE (status = 'ofrecida'::text)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_offers_live_slot_uniq ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (service_id, center_slug, slot_at) WHERE (status = 'ofrecida'::text)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_offers_pkey ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX appointment_offers_slot_idx ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (slot_at, service_id, center_slug)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX appointment_offers_token_key ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (token)
  CREATE INDEX appointment_offers_waitlist_idx ON public.appointment_offers USING btree (waitlist_id)

TABLE attendance_events
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('attendance_events_id_seq'::regclass)
  request_id integer NOT NULL
  dni text NOT NULL
  attendance_from text
  attendance_to text NOT NULL
  operator text NOT NULL
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sana'::text
  created timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT attendance_events_attendance_from_check CHECK ((attendance_from = ANY (ARRAY['presente'::text, 'ausente'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT attendance_events_attendance_to_check CHECK ((attendance_to = ANY (ARRAY['presente'::text, 'ausente'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT attendance_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT attendance_events_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['sana'::text, 'hsi'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_events_request FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES booking_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CREATE INDEX attendance_events_dni_idx ON public.attendance_events USING btree (dni, created DESC)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX attendance_events_pkey ON public.attendance_events USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX attendance_events_request_idx ON public.attendance_events USING btree (request_id, created DESC)

TABLE booking_requests
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('booking_requests_id_seq'::regclass)
  dni text
  first_name text
  last_name text
  birth_date date
  sex text
  contact text
  service_id text
  center_slug text
  status text DEFAULT 'pendiente'::text
  referral_path text
  referral_mime text
  ai_json jsonb
  rejection_reason text
  appointment_at timestamp with time zone
  hsi_patient_id text
  hsi_appointment_id text
  hsi_status text
  attendance text
  attendance_updated_at timestamp with time zone
  attendance_updated_by text
  overbooking boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  created timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now()
  time_preference text
  requester_dni text
  assigned_doctor text
  assigned_doctor_id text
  reminder_at timestamp with time zone
  interview_reminder_at timestamp with time zone
  resolved_by text
  resolved_at timestamp with time zone
  confirmation text
  confirmation_at timestamp with time zone
  confirmation_channel text
  confirm_token text
  cancelled_at timestamp with time zone
  slot_doctor_id text
  idem_key text
  patient_note text
  requested_at timestamp with time zone
  case_chat jsonb
  reminder_skipped boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  CONSTRAINT booking_requests_attendance_check CHECK ((attendance = ANY (ARRAY['presente'::text, 'ausente'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT booking_requests_confirmation_check CHECK ((confirmation = ANY (ARRAY['si'::text, 'no'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT booking_requests_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX booking_requests_confirm_token_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (confirm_token)
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_dni_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (dni)
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_doctor_appointment_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (assigned_doctor_id, appointment_at) WHERE ((assigned_doctor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (appointment_at IS NOT NULL))
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX booking_requests_doctor_slot_uniq ON public.booking_requests USING btree (assigned_doctor_id, appointment_at) WHERE ((status = 'aprobada'::text) AND (NOT overbooking) AND (assigned_doctor_id IS NOT NULL) AND (appointment_at IS NOT NULL))
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_hsi_appt_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (hsi_appointment_id) WHERE (hsi_appointment_id IS NOT NULL)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX booking_requests_idem_key_uniq ON public.booking_requests USING btree (idem_key) WHERE (idem_key IS NOT NULL)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX booking_requests_pkey ON public.booking_requests USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_requester_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (requester_dni)
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_status_appointment_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (status, appointment_at)
  CREATE INDEX booking_requests_status_created_idx ON public.booking_requests USING btree (status, created DESC)

TABLE chat_messages
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('chat_messages_id_seq'::regclass)
  channel text NOT NULL
  key text NOT NULL
  role text NOT NULL
  content jsonb NOT NULL
  created timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT chat_messages_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CREATE INDEX chat_messages_conv_idx ON public.chat_messages USING btree (channel, key, created)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX chat_messages_pkey ON public.chat_messages USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX chat_messages_whatsapp_tel_idx ON public.chat_messages USING btree (channel, "right"(regexp_replace(key, '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 10)) WHERE (channel = 'whatsapp'::text)

TABLE consultations
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('consultations_id_seq'::regclass)
  interview_id bigint NOT NULL
  doctor_id text NOT NULL
  diagnoses jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  exams jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  meds jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  notes text
  receta_json jsonb
  orden_json jsonb
  receta_token text
  orden_token text
  created timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  created_by text
  superseded_at timestamp with time zone
  superseded_by bigint
  CONSTRAINT consultations_orden_token_key UNIQUE (orden_token)
  CONSTRAINT consultations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT consultations_receta_token_key UNIQUE (receta_token)
  CONSTRAINT fk_consultations_interview FOREIGN KEY (interview_id) REFERENCES interviews(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CONSTRAINT fk_consultations_superseded_by FOREIGN KEY (superseded_by) REFERENCES consultations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CREATE INDEX consultations_interview_idx ON public.consultations USING btree (interview_id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consultations_orden_token_key ON public.consultations USING btree (orden_token)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consultations_pkey ON public.consultations USING btree (id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consultations_receta_token_key ON public.consultations USING btree (receta_token)
  CREATE INDEX consultations_superseded_by_idx ON public.consultations USING btree (superseded_by)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX consultations_vigente_uniq ON public.consultations USING btree (interview_id) WHERE (superseded_at IS NULL)

  CONSTRAINT dni_claims_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['unverified'::text, 'pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'rejected'::text])))

  hsi_patient_id text

  observed_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT hsi_appointments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (hsi_appointment_id)
  CREATE INDEX hsi_appointments_diary_idx ON public.hsi_appointments USING btree (hsi_diary_id)
  CREATE INDEX hsi_appointments_patient_idx ON public.hsi_appointments USING btree (hsi_patient_id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hsi_appointments_pkey ON public.hsi_appointments USING btree (hsi_appointment_id)

  reconciled_at timestamp with time zone
  state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
  conflict jsonb

  CONSTRAINT hsi_inbox_source_key_key UNIQUE (source_key)
  CONSTRAINT hsi_inbox_state_check CHECK ((state = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'conflict'::text, 'error'::text])))
  CREATE INDEX hsi_inbox_pending_idx ON public.hsi_inbox USING btree (state, observed_at)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hsi_inbox_pkey ON public.hsi_inbox USING btree (id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX hsi_inbox_source_key_key ON public.hsi_inbox USING btree (source_key)

TABLE interviews
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('interviews_id_seq'::regclass)
  doctor_id text
  request_id integer
  entry_mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'qr'::text
  entered_name text
  entered_surname text
  matched boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  dni text
  session_key text NOT NULL
  patient_token text
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'::text
  triage text
  summary text
  brief jsonb
  differential jsonb
  suggested_exams jsonb
  red_flags jsonb
  ai_model text
  analyzed_at timestamp with time zone
  created timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  updated timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  detached_request_id integer
  alert_seen_at timestamp with time zone
  alert_seen_by text
  reopened_at timestamp with time zone
  CONSTRAINT fk_interviews_request FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES booking_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CONSTRAINT interviews_patient_token_key UNIQUE (patient_token)
  CONSTRAINT interviews_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT interviews_session_key_key UNIQUE (session_key)
  CREATE INDEX interviews_doctor_day_idx ON public.interviews USING btree (doctor_id, created)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interviews_patient_token_idx ON public.interviews USING btree (patient_token)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interviews_patient_token_key ON public.interviews USING btree (patient_token)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interviews_pkey ON public.interviews USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX interviews_red_alert_idx ON public.interviews USING btree (doctor_id) WHERE ((triage = 'ROJO'::text) AND (alert_seen_at IS NULL))
  CREATE INDEX interviews_request_idx ON public.interviews USING btree (request_id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interviews_request_uniq ON public.interviews USING btree (request_id) WHERE (request_id IS NOT NULL)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX interviews_session_key_key ON public.interviews USING btree (session_key)

TABLE study_events
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('study_events_id_seq'::regclass)
  session_id bigint NOT NULL
  recorded_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  task_id text NOT NULL
  t integer NOT NULL
  kind text NOT NULL
  target jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  path text NOT NULL
  CONSTRAINT fk_study_events_session FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES study_sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CONSTRAINT study_events_kind_check CHECK ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['click'::text, 'nav'::text, 'dead_click'::text, 'scroll_stop'::text, 'visibility'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT study_events_t_check CHECK (((t >= 0) AND (t <= 86400000)))
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_events_pkey ON public.study_events USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX study_events_session ON public.study_events USING btree (session_id, task_id)

TABLE study_findings
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('study_findings_id_seq'::regclass)
  title text NOT NULL
  detail text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  role text NOT NULL
  task_id text NOT NULL
  kind text
  severity text NOT NULL
  source text NOT NULL
  evidence_summary jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'found'::text
  fix_note text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  commit text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  live_url text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  decided_by text
  decided_at timestamp with time zone
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT study_findings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT study_findings_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['patient'::text, 'doctor'::text, 'admin'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_findings_severity_check CHECK ((severity = ANY (ARRAY['low'::text, 'medium'::text, 'high'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_findings_source_check CHECK ((source = ANY (ARRAY['auto'::text, 'manual'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_findings_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['found'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'fixed'::text, 'not_done'::text, 'dismissed'::text])))
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_findings_auto ON public.study_findings USING btree (task_id, kind) WHERE (source = 'auto'::text)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_findings_pkey ON public.study_findings USING btree (id)

  CONSTRAINT study_sessions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT study_sessions_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['patient'::text, 'doctor'::text, 'admin'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_sessions_token_hash_key UNIQUE (token_hash)
  CONSTRAINT study_sessions_user_agent_class_check CHECK ((user_agent_class = ANY (ARRAY['mobile'::text, 'tablet'::text, 'desktop'::text])))

  CREATE INDEX study_sessions_retention ON public.study_sessions USING btree (started_at)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_sessions_token_hash_key ON public.study_sessions USING btree (token_hash)

TABLE study_task_results
  id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('study_task_results_id_seq'::regclass)
  session_id bigint NOT NULL
  task_id text NOT NULL
  outcome text NOT NULL
  ease integer
  comment text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  duration_ms integer NOT NULL
  started_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL
  ended_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT fk_study_task_results_session FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES study_sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CONSTRAINT study_task_results_duration_ms_check CHECK (((duration_ms >= 0) AND (duration_ms <= 86400000)))
  CONSTRAINT study_task_results_ease_check CHECK (((ease >= 1) AND (ease <= 5)))
  CONSTRAINT study_task_results_outcome_check CHECK ((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['ok'::text, 'doubt'::text, 'stuck'::text, 'skipped'::text])))
  CONSTRAINT study_task_results_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CONSTRAINT study_task_results_session_id_task_id_key UNIQUE (session_id, task_id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_task_results_pkey ON public.study_task_results USING btree (id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX study_task_results_session_id_task_id_key ON public.study_task_results USING btree (session_id, task_id)

  mcp_token_at timestamp with time zone
  mcp_token_used timestamp with time zone
  CONSTRAINT users_dni_key UNIQUE (dni)
  CONSTRAINT users_feed_token_key UNIQUE (feed_token)
  CONSTRAINT users_mcp_token_key UNIQUE (mcp_token)
  CONSTRAINT users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CREATE INDEX users_active_idx ON public.users USING btree (active)
  CREATE INDEX users_contact_tel_idx ON public.users USING btree ("right"(regexp_replace(contact, '\D'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 10)) WHERE (contact IS NOT NULL)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_dni_key ON public.users USING btree (dni)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_feed_token_key ON public.users USING btree (feed_token)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_mcp_token_key ON public.users USING btree (mcp_token)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_portal_user_id_uniq ON public.users USING btree (portal_user_id) WHERE (portal_user_id IS NOT NULL)

TABLE waitlist
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('waitlist_id_seq'::regclass)
  request_id integer
  dni text
  email text
  service_id text
  center_slug text
  appointment_at timestamp with time zone
  active boolean DEFAULT true
  created timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now()
  CONSTRAINT fk_waitlist_request FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES booking_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
  CONSTRAINT waitlist_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  CREATE INDEX waitlist_created_idx ON public.waitlist USING btree (service_id, center_slug, created) WHERE active
  CREATE UNIQUE INDEX waitlist_pkey ON public.waitlist USING btree (id)
  CREATE INDEX waitlist_request_idx ON public.waitlist USING btree (request_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinical_access_log_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'DELETE'
       AND current_setting('turnos.access_log_purge', true) = 'on'
       AND OLD.ts < now() - interval '365 days' THEN
        RETURN OLD;
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'clinical_access_log es de sólo agregado'
        USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.data_subject_request_events_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'data_subject_request_events es de sólo agregado'
        USING ERRCODE = 'insufficient_privilege';
END
$function$
